archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) blended with Archetype 7 (Electric/Neon) for a Premium AI-Native aesthetic.

brand.name: OtsAI
brand.positioning: An AI that generates anything you ask for. Premium, builder-focused, and slightly futuristic.
brand.vibe: Moody, highly polished, sophisticated dark mode driven by deep emeralds and electric mints, rejecting typical SaaS gradients.

rules: Never center-align headings by default; embrace left-alignment and asymmetry.
Limit heading weights to 'medium' or 'light' for elegance, do not default to black/bold unless for numbers.
NO pure #000000; always use #030705 (deep forest void).
Colors must meet APCA contrast guidelines.

grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Use Mode A (Tetris Grid) - asymmetric spanning (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use Mode B (Control Room Grid) - dense, metric-focused.

rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Embrace negative space. Do not fill 100% of grids perfectly in marketing sections.
Images must not exceed max-h-[80vh] on mobile devices.

navigation.behavior: Sticky (top-0, z-50). Links left-aligned, CTA right-aligned. MUST be visible on desktop.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00FFA3] text-[#030705] hover:bg-[#A3E635] font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#F4FFF9] border border-[#172A1F] hover:border-[#00FFA3] hover:text-[#00FFA3] px-6 py-3 rounded-none transition-colors

cards.default: bg-[#08120B] border border-[#172A1F] p-8 rounded-none transition-all hover:border-[#264231] hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-[#00FFA3]/5
cards.generation_output: bg-[#030705] border border-[#172A1F] p-6 font-mono text-[#9EAF9C]

inputs.default: bg-[#030705] border border-[#172A1F] text-[#F4FFF9] placeholder-[#7D8B7A] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00FFA3] focus:border-[#00FFA3] rounded-none px-4 py-3

forms.rules: Use Shadcn customized components. Strip generic Vercel looks. Use sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).

animations.micro: Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) on cards, crisp transition-colors (duration-200 ease-out) on interactive elements.
animations.page: Subtle opacity and slight Y-axis translation fade-ins (framer-motion).
animations.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations must feel mechanical and snappy, not overly bouncy.

hero_background.description: Abstract neon green glowing waves for the hero background.
hero_background.placement: Behind the hero section with a heavy gradient overlay to ensure text contrast.

contextual.description: Minimalist dark green potted plant, good for profile or about section accents.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

page_level_instructions.landing_page: Hero must use 'hero_background' with heavy left-alignment. Generous padding. Features grid must be asymmetric.
page_level_instructions.dashboard: Bento-style Control Room grid. Include a high-contrast 'Credit Balance' card. Sidebar or topnav must use glassmorphism.
page_level_instructions.generation_workspace: Model selector dropdown (GPT-5.2 / Claude / Gemini). Large prompt input. Output panel uses JetBrains Mono with absolute precision.
page_level_instructions.admin_panel: Dense data tables (Shadcn customized). Include 'Credit Adjustment Modal' and Audit Logs. Minimal padding in data rows for high density.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark green color palette. Avoid generic blues or purples entirely.
Ensure all Shadcn components (buttons, inputs, cards, dialogs, tables) are overridden to match the sharp, minimal, rounded-none or max rounded-sm borders as defined.
NEVER use placeholder text or generic fake image URLs. Use the provided media URLs exclusively.
Apply data-testid to every button, form, input, and interactive link.
